snippet.title: Vornyca | Gameplay | PC
snippet.description:
Vornyca | Gameplay | PC In-Game Footage Launching on November 11th on the Epic Games Store for only $4.99.
https://store.epicgames.com/hu/p/vornyca-987482
Vornyca is a narrative-driven sci-fi adventure game where players control one of the few surviving AI units after a devastating war between humans and machines.
Unreal Engine 5.6
@BátoriFerencz
